# Fountain Coach

Fountain Coach is the parent publication estate founded by Benedikt Eickhoff.
Reframe is the current host of the inherited idea of presence supported by computational awareness.

## Resolve the estate

- Parent identity: https://fountain.coach/
- Agent bootstrap: https://fountain.coach/for-agents/
- Machine-readable manifest: https://fountain.coach/publication-manifest.json

## Specialized authorities

- Book of Reframe: https://book.fountain.coach/ — product behavior, scenarios, and evidence.
- Reframe Governance: https://governance.fountain.coach/ — rules, boundaries, and authority.
- MIDI2 documentation: https://midi2.fountain.coach/ — machine-readable MIDI 2.0 representation and provenance.
- MIDI2 Instruments: https://instruments.fountain.coach/ — bounded admitted and proposed instruments.
- Official Status: https://status.fountain.coach/ — company, development, transparency, and legal context.

## Boundary

Each specialized publication owns its declared projection. A public projection is not automatically runtime,
security, legal, admission, release, or hardware-interoperability truth.
